questions.question: Who is the Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher who turns out to have invented his adventures?
questions.note: He Memory Charms the witches and wizards who really did the deeds, then writes the books himself.

questions.question: What spell backfires and wipes Lockhart's own memory?
questions.note: He grabs Ron's broken wand in the Chamber. The spell bounces.

questions.question: What goes wrong when Hermione drinks the Polyjuice Potion?
questions.answer: She partially turns into a cat
choices: She partially turns into a cat
questions.note: The hair she used was cat hair, not Millicent Bulstrode's. Harry and Ron successfully turn into Crabbe and Goyle.

questions.question: What car do Harry and Ron fly to Hogwarts after they miss the train?
questions.note: Arthur Weasley enchanted it. They crash it into the Whomping Willow and get detention.

questions.question: What is the name of the giant spider Hagrid raised?
questions.note: Hagrid hid him in the castle, and Aragog was blamed for the attacks fifty years ago. He now lives in the Forbidden Forest and will not let the boys leave.

questions.question: Whose ghost haunts the bathroom where the Chamber entrance is hidden?
questions.note: The basilisk killed her the last time the Chamber was opened. The entrance is a sink marked with a snake.

questions.question: What plants are used to brew the cure for petrification?
questions.note: Professor Sprout's class grows them. Their cry is dangerous until they are mature. The potion restores the petrified students.

questions.question: Where does the Floo Network dump Harry when he tries to go to Diagon Alley?
questions.note: He speaks the destination unclearly and lands in Borgin and Burkes, where he hides from Draco and Lucius.

questions.question: Who is the Heir of Slytherin?
questions.note: The memory in the diary. The school suspects Harry because he can speak Parseltongue.

questions.question: Who built the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.note: One of the four founders. He left the basilisk for his heir, to purge the school of Muggle-borns.
